concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-mb-way-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured MB WAY Web Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for statement or standard phone fields, optional MBWay import, Pending/await action and a separately scoped mobile App2App section.
warnings: The Web page's Sessions TEST request uses a mobile-style adyencheckout:// returnUrl; configure the actual Web return path.
The mobile App2App section does not remove the standard Web phone-number requirement, and Pending/app return is not final authorization.
